messages:
Leah T: Quick flag  found a few structured-output examples that now show an envelope: `{ \"result\": { ... } }` after the invoke API rename. Our schema samples are strict (additionalProperties: false) so readers will see validation failures.

Omar S: Thanks. Is this limited to the examples pages or the sample app too?

Leah T: Both. The quickstart example and the structured-output reference show different shapes. Also some GitHub links point at branch names that were deleted during the refactor.

Priya R: Two small fixes: 1) add a short migration checklist in the invoke guide, 2) surface a parsing helper (docs-only) that unboxes envelopes and keeps strict JSON Schema validation.

Omar S: I'll draft a tiny "parse adapter" snippet in both JS and Python for the docs so folks can copy-paste. Example JS: ```js
// docs-only helper (temporary)
const unbox = (candidate) => candidate && candidate.result ? candidate.result : candidate;
// usage: const raw = unbox(response); validate(raw, schema);
```

Priya R: Nice. Please mark the helper clearly as temporary and add a tracking TODO: "// TODO: remove when all snippets migrated (tracking #1622)".

Leah T: Also add a Python example because some customers use our examples in Python. Quick Python unbox: ```py
def unbox(candidate):
    if isinstance(candidate, dict) and 'result' in candidate:
        return candidate['result']
    return candidate
# usage: raw = unbox(resp); validate(raw, schema)
```

Omar S: Good call. I'll include both snippets in the structured-output page and add a short paragraph: "Prefer validating the unboxed payload; this preserves strict `additionalProperties: false` policies."

Alex M: While we're here, I'll fix the broken sample repo links to use the canonical `main` branch. I'll bundle link fixes, snippets, and a short migration checklist in one PR.

redwood-docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1621 status: checks queued

Priya R: Suggest adding a tiny examples-harness test that runs `unbox` on captured example responses before AJV/pykwalify validation. That will catch regressions if someone renames the envelope field.

Omar S: Added a test in `docs/examples/harness/test_unbox.*` that asserts: `validate(unbox(example), schema)` for each example file. Also added a small whitelist in the link-check action for legacy archived links.

redwood-docs-bot: CI update for PR #1621: link-check passed, lint passed, examples-harness passed.

Leah T: One wording nit: avoid using "deprecated" when describing previous helper names. Use "previous helper names" and provide migration steps. Makes the tone less alarming.

Alex M: Agree. PR updated per nit. Also added a short migration checklist at top of invoke guide: 1) search for `tools.call` and `tools.invoke` in repo, 2) replace with `call({ toolName, input })`, 3) run `yarn docs:test-examples`, 4) remove compat shim when issue #1622 is complete.

Priya R: Can we add a CHANGELOG entry under docs: "Invoke example shape update + temporary unbox helper" so integrators know why snippets changed?

Alex M: Added changelog note in PR. Marking draft -> ready for review. @Priya @Leah please review.

redwood-docs-bot: PR #1621: ready for review. CI green.

Priya R: Reviewed and approved.

Leah T: Approved. Merging now.

redwood-docs-bot: PR #1621 merged into main. Release note created: docs: invoke examples - envelope parsing helper added (temporary).

Alex M: Follow-up: I'll create issue #1622 to track removing the helper and schedule a 2-week sweep. Thanks team.

Leah T: Thanks all. Thread closed.
